topic.angle: Meta's new Muse AI agent gets video calling, its own email, and a Tamagotchi-style gadget

draft.title: Meta gives its AI agent an email address
draft.script:
Your AI assistant is about to get its very own email inbox.
Meta just updated its Muse AI agent to handle tasks directly through email.
You can now even have real time video chats with the bot.
This means your personal AI can coordinate schedules and talk to you face to face.
Follow for daily AI news at gradientailabs.
draft.caption: Meta is upgrading its Muse AI agent with email capabilities and video chat features, making it act more like a personal assistant. How would you feel about your AI having its own email inbox? Let us know in the comments.
